description: Use this when someone asks which frauds the banks, mobile networks and public bodies of Kenya or Nigeria have described, or how a named one works (for example a fake reversal instruction, a one-ring call from abroad, or a message about your BVN). Do not use it for other countries, and do not present the list as complete: it covers patterns that were found described on the bodies' own pages. Do not use it to decide whether a message is fine.

country.description: The country the message or call is about: kenya or nigeria.

pattern.description: One pattern's id, for its full description. Leave out for the list. Ids for kenya: bank_secret_request, bank_link_sms, sim_swap, cheap_goods_deal, advance_fee_payout, fake_payment_or_overpayment, one_ring_foreign_call, safaricom_impersonation, fake_reversal_instructions, win_or_cash_offer, threat_or_paid_information, fake_emergency_send_money, job_fee, kra_officer_bribe, fake_money_transfer_receipt, unlicensed_investment. Ids for nigeria: bvn_messages, bank_card_pin_otp_request, bank_verify_email_link, sim_swap, relative_name_money, unregistered_investment, loan_app_harassment, cloned_page_donation.

name: africa_scams.list_patterns
title: Common scams described in Kenya or Nigeria
